I now have the full pattern needed. Here's the complete file list and changes, modeled on the existing `levelup`/`shop` features:

## Worker (`worker/src`)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`routes/rest.ts`** (new) | New `restRoutes` Hono router. `POST /api/rest` — validates `{ sessionId, characterId }`, loads character via `getCharacter`, computes cost (e.g. `REST_COST = 10` gold or `(max_hp - hp) * costPerHp`), rejects if `gold < cost` or `hp === max_hp` (400), rejects if in combat, then calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: character.max_hp, gold: character.gold - cost })`. Inserts an `adventure_log` row (`actor: 'system'`, e.g. `"${name} rests at the inn and recovers to full health."`), updates the KV session (`loadSession`/`saveSession`, push `{role:'dm', content: narrative}` similar to `levelup.ts`), returns `{ narrative, updatedCharacter, cost }`. |
| **`index.ts`** | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes);`. |
| **`types/index.ts`** | Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: string; }` interface; add a `REST_COST` (or `GOLD_PER_HP_HEALED`) constant alongside `XP_THRESHOLDS`. |
| **`services/character.ts`** (optional) | Optionally add a small `restAtInn(db, character, cost)` helper wrapping the `updateCharacter` call, for symmetry with `levelUp()`. |

## Frontend (`frontend/src/app`)

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| **`services/game-api.service.ts`** | Add `restAtInn(sessionId: string, characterId: string): Observable<{ narrative: string; updatedCharacter: Character; cost: number }>` posting to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. |
| **`models/game.models.ts`** | Add `REST_COST` constant (mirroring worker) if the UI needs to show/validate cost client-side before calling the API. |
| **`components/game-console/game-console.component.ts`** | Add `restAtInn()` method (same pattern as `levelUp()`): guard on `loading()`/combat, call `api.restAtInn`, then `charSvc.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`, `pushEntry('system', ...)`. |
| **`components/game-console/game-console.component.html`** | Add a "Rest at the Inn" button in `sidebar-actions` (next to the Inventory button), disabled when `charSvc.inCombat()` or gold `< REST_COST` or `hp === max_hp`. |
| **`services/character-state.service.ts`** | No change needed — `setCharacter` already updates `hp`/`gold` and derived `hpPercent`. |

No DB migration is required since `hp`/`gold` columns already exist on `characters`.
